buildCommand: node scripts/vercel-chromium.mjs && node scripts/generate-tool-docs.mjs && playwright install chromium && next build
ignoreCommand: ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && if git -C "$ROOT" diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- apps packages catalog pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml vercel.json package.json; then echo 'no site-relevant changes, skipping build'; exit 0; else echo 'site-relevant changes, building'; exit 1; fi
